features.title: Downstream invalidation

Spoken token/text/timing/language changes invalidate voice review/export; displayed-only edits do not. Source is checked again after native save selection.
features.remaining: Durable audio/alignment dependency graph, full speech pipeline restart and resource lifecycle.
